15.t: Working with data: where does plastic go?
q: What percentage of the world’s plastic waste is recycled?
Compare landfill in Country A and Country B.
B puts 60% in landfill, A only 24%: B uses landfill 2.5 times as much.
Give one advantage and one disadvantage of burning plastic for energy.
Advantage: saves landfill space and makes electricity. Disadvantage: releases CO₂ and possibly toxic gases.
Country B wants to cut plastic leaking into rivers. Recommend a plan using the data.
B leaks 18%: improve waste collection, add recycling, ban some single-use plastics, as Country A shows leaks can be cut to about 1%.
